title: WPSS/534/2022 of URBADUTT JOSHI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
ON THE 31ST DAY OF MARCH, 2022
BEFORE:
HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 534 of 2022
BETWEEN:
Urbadutt Joshi. .......Petitioner
(By Mr. Deepak Joshi, Advocate, holding brief of Mr. K.K. Harbola,
Advocate)
AND:
State of Uttarakhand & another. ...Respondents
(By Mr. Sachin Mohan Singh Mehta, Brief Holder for the
State/respondent no. 1 and Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, Advocate for
respondent no. 2)
JUDGMENT
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner served as Work Agent in
Uttarakhand Pey Jal Nigam and retired on 30.09.2019.
According to him, certain retiral dues are yet to be paid
to him. In this writ petition, petitioner has sought the
following reliefs:-
"i) To issue a writ order or direction in the nature of Mandamus
commanding the Respondents to forthwith release the
outstanding retiral benefits to the petitioner, details whereof is
given herein below:-
A. Leave Encashment (300 days)=Rs. 5,00,760/-(approx.)
(sanctioned but not paid)
B. Arrear of 7th Pay Commission= Rs. 48,528/- (approx.)
(sanctioned but not paid)
C. Arrear of Salary = Rs. 22,339/- (approx.)
(sanctioned but not paid)
Total Amount = Rs. 5,71,627/-(Approx)"

2
3. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, learned counsel
appearing for respondent no. 2 while admits the liability
to pay the retiral dues to petitioner, however, submits
that due to financial constraints, outstanding dues
could not be paid to the petitioner, in time. He assures
the Court that all the retiral dues would be paid to the
petitioner within three months.
4. Accordingly, writ petition is disposed of with
direction to respondent no. 2 to release all outstanding
dues to the petitioner, as early as possible, but not
later than three months from the date of production of
certified copy of this order.
(MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI, J.)
Navin
